title: Committee of Supply – Heads B, C, D, E, G and Z
what_it_is: Committee of Supply – Heads B, C, D, E, G and Z

sections.label: Main and Development Estimates Heads
sections.summary: The passage lists the Heads of Expenditure for the Main Estimates and the Development Estimates, proposing to take the Main Estimates Heads en bloc.

sentences.speaker: The Chairman
sentences.text: In respect of the Main Estimates, they are Heads B, C, D, E, G and Z.

sentences.speaker: The Chairman
sentences.text: I propose to take those Heads of Expenditure en bloc.

sentences.speaker: The Chairman
sentences.text: In respect of the Development Estimates, they are Heads B, C, D and E.
